notes: school_dates contains only weekday dates within the student attendance span that are explicitly identified as no school, teacher inservice/workdays with no school, holidays, or intersession dates.
Weekends are omitted. The July 3, 2026 holiday is before the first student day; the May 31, 2027 holiday is after the last student day; both are therefore omitted from school_dates.

The calendar labels intersession periods but does not explicitly say whether optional intersession programs operate. These dates are treated as no regular school for the standard student calendar; verify local enrollment/program needs before applying if attendance is expected.
Parent/teacher conferences and early release days are not marked no_school and are omitted. The May 20 last day is a half day but remains a school day.
The source does not provide a Day 1–4 rotation. No cycle-day assignments are invented.
